svg.title: testing program
svg.desc: A check mark whose three corners are nodes: one check run in three places, the laptop, the cloud and GitHub, cut from an amber-600 tile. Drawn on the drawn-mark box and rules (docs/favicons/README.md): solid fills, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16. The ideas it was chosen from are in docs/prototypes/program-mark-ideas.html.
